name: APT Mirror
description: Points Ubuntu's default apt sources (archive.ubuntu.com, security.ubuntu.com) at a different mirror.

mirror.description: The mirror base URL to replace archive.ubuntu.com with (e.g. 'http://jp.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu'). Leave empty to make no change.

include_security.description: Also replace security.ubuntu.com with 'mirror'. Mirrors sync on their own schedule and can lag behind security.ubuntu.com, so this defaults to false and keeps security updates coming straight from Canonical's own server.
